items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: the one on Central was Harry Bigelow's place.

ctx.x: Where else did you hear music besides on Main Street?

Let's see, I can't remember this club. It was a gay club, on the northeast corner of Central Avenue, across the street from the Downbeat. And the Mason Brothers had the band there, the Grand Mason and his brother, they had the band. And then after hours spots, Tatum's place, the Apex, back there at the back, on the east side of the street -- no, the Apex is on Vernon, I'm sorry, the one on Central was Harry Bigelow's place. And I don't know what the name of it was.
Oh, I played with a band out here, a large band -- Happy Johnson. He was a trombone player, and -- how did that jump up in my mind? Happy Johnson.
